Test Scenarios

  • #submit-btn - Button with exact ID match
  • "submit" - Fuzzy match should find Submit, Submit Form
  • #hidden-display - Hidden with display:none
  • #disabled-btn - Disabled button
  • #covered-btn - Covered when modal is open
  • "login" - Fuzzy match should find login link
